property_summary: For any fuzzed caller and calldata, c.forward(callee, data) invoked against a callee whose fallback succeeds must itself complete without reverting; the mutant inverts the success check and reverts exactly when the external call succeeds, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Invert the success check from require(_s) to require(!_s) so the call reverts on success and proceeds on failure.
